audit.whatIsWrong: phases[4..6].side read 'Skill' while content win[4..6] and packet.levelChart read Naafiri, Naafiri, Azir. Three rows disagreed across layers.
audit.why: 47.2% over 1106 games with a level chart that stays Naafiri through first item is consistent: her Q is 900 range on 9s at rank 1 and Eviscerate is a 450-range dash on 11s, so she chooses every fight until Azir's soldier DPS is item-backed.
audit.corrected: phases[4].side -> Naafiri, phases[5].side -> Naafiri, phases[6].side -> Azir, each .why rewritten to match.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.spikes named no Naafiri timing and the anti-heal spike was absent entirely.
audit.why: Her spikes are level 6 Hounds' Pursuit (110/95/80s, 900 range, recasts for a shield) and any lead that makes the Q-into-E chain lethal. Azir's are Nashor's Tooth and level 6 Emperor's Divide (120/105/90s). Eviscerate recalling and fully healing the packmates is what makes chip damage on the dogs worthless.
audit.corrected: breakdown.spikes and phases[4..6].why now carry those timings; Grievous Wounds named.

audit.whatIsWrong: Packet defect: not one Naafiri ability was named. breakdown.cooldowns had no digit.
audit.why: Decisive interactions: (a) Darkin Daggers is the engage trigger, not Hounds' Pursuit — packmates leap to the FIRST champion or monster it hits, so standing behind minions means the dagger lands on a minion and the pack never reaches you; (b) Eviscerate (450 range, 11/10/9/8/7s) recalls and fully heals her packmates, which is why chipping the dogs between casts achieves nothing; (c) The Call of the Pack makes her Untargetable on 26s at rank 1; (d) Emperor's Divide knocks back and damages, which is Azir's answer to the pack's approach; (e) Hounds' Pursuit recasts once for a shield, so the first knock-back is not the end of it.
audit.corrected: Written into breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0].d, dosFull[2].d and enemyWin.

audit.why: Hounds' Pursuit 110/95/80, Darkin Daggers 9/8.5/8/7.5/7, Eviscerate 11/10/9/8/7, Shifting Sands 22/20.5/19/17.5/16 are all in the kits.
audit.corrected: Real numbers now in breakdown.cooldowns and the punishable window is named as both Q and E being down.

audit.whatIsWrong: Twenty-one MISGENDER hits and two COPY_PASTE_BLEED bullets.
audit.why: Naafiri is she/her per champ-gender.js; dosFull[1].d was tradeGood verbatim and dontsFull[2].d was tradeBad verbatim.
audit.corrected: All pronouns fixed; both bleed bullets replaced with bodies that match their titles (roam pings).

notes: CHART: phases[4..6].side were the stale token 'Skill' while content win[4..6] and packet.levelChart already read Naafiri/Naafiri/Azir. Full layer moved onto the content layer's answer, so no paired win[N] edit exists to propose — win[N] is already correct on disk for all three rows, and each .why was rewritten in this same proposal. Ratings left untouched (orientation of the rating scale is ambiguous). KIT DISCREPANCY: the derived 'heal' flag on Eviscerate is on Naafiri, but Riot's own description says the dash 'recalls her packmates and fully healing them' — the heal is on the PACKMATES, not on Naafiri. Per the brief's rule I followed the description: the anti-heal advice is written as Grievous Wounds blunting Eviscerate's pack sustain, and nothing claims Naafiri herself heals. Also deliberately unasserted: whether Emperor's Divide's wall blocks her Hounds' Pursuit dash — Riot's text only supports the knock-back, so the copy says knocked back, not blocked.
